mfa_enforced.title: MFA Enforced for Remote Access
mfa_enforced.description: Indicates whether multi-factor authentication is required for all VPN or remote access sessions, preventing password-only authentication. Also reduces practical impact of brute-force attacks when lockout is absent.

certificate_based_auth_enabled.title: Certificate-Based Authentication Enabled
certificate_based_auth_enabled.description: Indicates whether client certificate authentication is required or accepted as a primary authentication factor for VPN sessions, providing a stronger alternative to password-only access.

authentication_method.title: Primary Authentication Method
authentication_method.description: The authentication mechanism configured for remote access sessions on the VPN gateway.

enabled_cipher_suites.title: Enabled Cipher Suites
enabled_cipher_suites.description: List of encryption cipher suites currently configured and accepted by the VPN gateway.

minimum_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version
minimum_tls_version.description: The lowest TLS protocol version the VPN gateway will accept for SSL-VPN or management connections.

weak_hmac_algorithms_enabled.title: Weak HMAC Algorithms Enabled
weak_hmac_algorithms_enabled.description: Whether the VPN gateway accepts MD5 or SHA-1 as HMAC integrity algorithms for tunnel authentication.

split_tunneling_enabled.title: Split Tunneling Enabled
split_tunneling_enabled.description: Indicates whether split tunneling is active on the VPN gateway, allowing clients to route non-corporate traffic outside the VPN tunnel while simultaneously connected to internal resources.

split_tunnel_policy_enforced.title: Split Tunnel Policy Enforced
split_tunnel_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether an approved, granular access control list or firewall policy restricts which subnets/domains are accessible outside the tunnel when split tunneling is enabled.

endpoint_security_posture_check.title: Endpoint Security Posture Check Enforced (Split Tunnel)
endpoint_security_posture_check.description: Indicates whether the VPN gateway performs host posture assessment before allowing split tunnel sessions, reducing the risk of compromised endpoints acting as bridges.

network_access_scope.title: Network Access Scope
network_access_scope.description: Defines the breadth of internal network access granted to VPN-authenticated users in the access profile.

role_based_acl_enforced.title: Role-Based Network ACL Enforced
role_based_acl_enforced.description: Whether the VPN access profile applies differentiated network ACLs based on user role, group membership, or identity attributes rather than a single permissive policy.

permitted_destination_subnets.title: Permitted Destination Subnets
permitted_destination_subnets.description: List of destination subnet CIDRs explicitly allowed in the VPN access profile. Contains overly broad entries if full RFC1918 space or 0.0.0.0/0 is present.

certificate_type.title: Server Certificate Type
certificate_type.description: Indicates whether the VPN gateway's server certificate is issued by a trusted CA, is self-signed, or uses no certificate at all.

certificate_expired.title: Server Certificate Expired
certificate_expired.description: Indicates whether the VPN gateway's server certificate has passed its NotAfter date and is therefore expired.

client_certificate_validation_enforced.title: Client Certificate Validation Enforced
client_certificate_validation_enforced.description: Indicates whether the VPN gateway is configured to validate the client's certificate chain against a trusted CA store, preventing acceptance of self-signed or invalid client certificates.

version_has_known_cve.title: Version Has Known CVE
version_has_known_cve.description: Indicates whether the installed VPN software version is listed in a CVE database or vendor advisory as vulnerable, particularly to pre-authentication RCE or authentication bypass.

patch_lag_days.title: Patch Lag (Days Since Patch Available)
patch_lag_days.description: Number of days elapsed since the vendor released a patch addressing the known CVE(s) affecting the installed version.

cve_allows_preauthentication_exploit.title: CVE Allows Pre-Authentication Exploitation
cve_allows_preauthentication_exploit.description: True if at least one applicable CVE permits exploitation without valid credentials (e.g., pre-auth RCE, authentication bypass, unauthenticated path traversal).

idle_timeout_minutes.title: VPN Session Idle Timeout (Minutes)
idle_timeout_minutes.description: The number of minutes of inactivity after which a VPN session is automatically terminated. A value of 0 means no idle timeout is configured.

max_session_duration_hours.title: Maximum VPN Session Duration (Hours)
max_session_duration_hours.description: The maximum allowed lifetime of a VPN session in hours before mandatory re-authentication is required. A value of 0 means no maximum session duration is enforced.

session_reauthentication_enforced.title: Session Re-authentication Enforced
session_reauthentication_enforced.description: Indicates whether VPN sessions require periodic re-authentication (e.g., MFA re-prompt or credential refresh) before the session maximum is reached.

management_interface_network_exposure.title: Management Interface Network Exposure
management_interface_network_exposure.description: Indicates which network zones can reach the VPN management interface (SSH, web UI, SNMP). 'any' means no restriction, 'restricted' means limited to management VLAN or bastion host only, 'internal_only' means reachable from internal networks but not a dedicated management segment.

management_protocols_enabled.title: Enabled Management Protocols
management_protocols_enabled.description: List of management protocols actively enabled on the VPN gateway (e.g., SSH, HTTPS, SNMP, Telnet, HTTP).

management_acl_configured.title: Management ACL Configured
management_acl_configured.description: Whether an explicit access control list or firewall rule restricts management interface access to trusted source addresses (management VLAN, bastion host IPs).

insecure_protocol_exposed.title: Insecure Management Protocol Exposed
insecure_protocol_exposed.description: Whether an inherently insecure management protocol (Telnet, HTTP, SNMPv1/v2c) is accessible from untrusted networks, transmitting credentials or configuration in cleartext.

psk_authentication_used.title: Pre-Shared Key Authentication Used
psk_authentication_used.description: Indicates whether IPsec or other VPN tunnel uses pre-shared key (PSK) authentication rather than certificate-based (PKI) authentication.

psk_uniqueness.title: Pre-Shared Key Uniqueness
psk_uniqueness.description: Indicates whether the PSK is unique per peer/tunnel, shared across multiple peers, or uses a known default/vendor-supplied value.

psk_minimum_length.title: Pre-Shared Key Minimum Length (characters)
psk_minimum_length.description: The minimum character length of the PSK(s) configured across all tunnel definitions on this gateway. Industry best practice requires at least 20 characters of high entropy.

auth_event_logging_enabled.title: Authentication Event Logging Enabled
auth_event_logging_enabled.description: Whether the VPN gateway is configured to log authentication events including failed attempts, successful logins, session initiations, and disconnects.

logged_auth_fields.title: Fields Captured in Authentication Logs
logged_auth_fields.description: List of data fields recorded per authentication event. Expected values include: timestamp, source_ip, username, device_id, session_id, event_type.

log_retention_days.title: Authentication Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days authentication logs are retained, enabling retrospective investigation of brute-force or credential-stuffing campaigns.

endpoint_posture_check_enabled.title: Endpoint Posture Check Enabled
endpoint_posture_check_enabled.description: Whether the VPN gateway enforces device health/posture assessment (OS patch level, EDR presence, disk encryption state) before granting tunnel access.

posture_enforcement_scope.title: Posture Enforcement Scope
posture_enforcement_scope.description: Defines which connection profiles or user groups have endpoint posture checks enforced. 'all' means all profiles enforce posture; 'partial' means only some profiles do; 'none' means no profiles enforce posture.

unmanaged_device_access_allowed.title: Unmanaged Device Access Allowed
unmanaged_device_access_allowed.description: Whether the VPN gateway explicitly permits connections from devices not enrolled in or recognized by the organization's device management system (MDM/UEM), even when posture checking is nominally configured.

vpn_service_account_privilege_level.title: VPN Service Account Privilege Level
vpn_service_account_privilege_level.description: The privilege level of the OS account under which the VPN service process runs.

service_account_is_shared.title: VPN Service Account Is Shared With Other Services
service_account_is_shared.description: Indicates whether the account used to run the VPN service is also used by other services or applications, increasing lateral movement risk if compromised.

plaintext_secrets_detected.title: Plaintext Secrets Detected in Config Files
plaintext_secrets_detected.description: Indicates whether pre-shared keys, private key passphrases, or service account credentials are stored in plaintext within VPN gateway configuration files on disk.

secrets_manager_integrated.title: Secrets Manager Integration Enabled
secrets_manager_integrated.description: Indicates whether the VPN gateway is configured to retrieve secrets from a dedicated secrets management solution (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault) rather than reading them from local config files.

config_file_permission_mode.title: Configuration File Permission Mode
config_file_permission_mode.description: The filesystem permission mode (octal string) of VPN configuration files containing sensitive credentials, indicating access control strength.

account_lockout_enabled.title: Account Lockout Policy Enabled
account_lockout_enabled.description: Whether the VPN gateway enforces an account lockout policy after a configurable number of consecutive failed authentication attempts, preventing brute-force attacks.

rate_limiting_enabled.title: Authentication Rate Limiting Enabled
rate_limiting_enabled.description: Whether the VPN gateway enforces rate limiting or throttling on authentication attempts per source IP or per user, slowing or blocking sustained brute-force or password-spray attacks.

max_failed_auth_attempts.title: Maximum Failed Authentication Attempts Before Lockout
max_failed_auth_attempts.description: The configured threshold of consecutive failed authentication attempts before the account or source IP is locked out or rate-limited. A value of 0 indicates no limit is configured.
